sentences.text:
RAJNIKANT PARSOTTAMDAS SHETH - C/O. M/S. NATWARLAL  GORDHANDA ================================================================
Appearance:
MR.J.K.SHAH, APP, (2) for the PETITIONER(s) No. 1 MR DK MODI(1317) for the RESPONDENT(s) No. 1 MR MD MODI(1318) for the RESPONDENT(s) No. 1 MR YN RAVANI(718) for the RESPONDENT(s) No. 2 RULE SERVED(64) for the RESPONDENT(s) No. 1,2 ================================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR.JUSTICE R.P.DHOLARIA  Date : 22/07/2018  ORAL ORDER IN LOK ADALAT
On this auspicious occasion of Lok Adalat, after successful conciliation, settlement is arrived at in this matter.
Mr. J.K.Shah, learned APP for the appellant-State, on instructions, has tendered withdrawal/compromise pursis today, duly signed by respective parties.
The same is ordered to be taken on record.

As such, on going through the records, it is noticed that the offence alleged against the original accused-respondent under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 is not serious in nature and the punishment or penalty prescribed for such offence is not substantial, and in view of the provisions of Section 51 and 52 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, it is compoundable under Section 69 of the said Act.
In view of the above, this appeal stands disposed of in terms of the withdrawal/compromise pursis.

The respondents are directed to pay towards litigation costs of Rs.3,000/- for R/CR.A/886/2012 ORDER vendor-accused, in all Rs.6,000/-, as agreed between the parties in lieu thereof in the office of the High Court Legal Services Committee within a period of four weeks failing which, the matter State Of Gujarat - On Behalf Of K C Kunbi, ... vs Rajnikant Parsottamdas Sheth - C/O. ...

on 22 July, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/56918652/
1 shall stand revived automatically and the said amount be transmitted to the concerned Municipal Corporation.
However, disposing of this matter will not affect any connected matters arising out of the same, incidental or any other proceedings, filed or to be filed before any other court.
It is also required to be noted that this order will not be treated as precedent in any future cases for reference.
With these observations, this appeal filed by the Appellant is disposed off in Lok Adalat.

(R.P.DHOLARIA, J) CHAIR PERSON Siddharth State Of Gujarat - On Behalf Of K C Kunbi, ... vs Rajnikant Parsottamdas Sheth - C/O. ... on 22 July, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/56918652/
